standard_reference: Freedesktop.org Desktop Menu Specification v1.1 (Main & Additional Categories) + POSIX CLI Taxonomy

native-elf.description: Native Linux ELF binaries (C/C++/Rust/Go/Unity/Godot/GTK/Qt) with isolated persistent sandbox HOME and automatic application directory mounting

appimage.description: AppImage single-file bundles; sets APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1 for FUSE-less execution and read-only binds the AppImage payload

electron.description: Electron / Chromium / CEF / NW.js applications; sets ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 so outer bwrap handles namespace isolation without nested sandbox conflicts

wine.description: Windows .exe executables and Wine/Proton/UMU runners; isolates host HOME via tmpfs and mounts WINEPREFIX and translation layer caches

interpreted.description: Interpreted and VM applications (Python / Java -jar / Shell / Node.js / Love2D); penetrates interpreter arguments to resolve and mount the target script directory

network.description: Network namespace sharing, DNS resolution (systemd-resolved/NetworkManager), and cross-distro CA root certificates

display.description: Video display output passthrough supporting both Wayland and X11/XWayland protocols

gpu.description: Cross-vendor hardware GPU acceleration covering AMD (/dev/kfd, /dev/dri), Intel (/dev/dri), NVIDIA (proprietary/open device nodes & libraries), and Vulkan/OpenCL ICDs

audio.description: Cross-backend audio output (speakers) and audio input (microphone) across PipeWire, PulseAudio, and ALSA

input.description: Input peripherals and game controllers (/dev/input, /dev/uinput, /dev/hidraw*), /run/udev device enumeration, and /dev/ntsync fast synchronization primitive

camera.description: Webcams and video capture devices via V4L2 and Media Controller (/dev/video*, /dev/media*, /dev/v4l*, /run/udev)

usb_serial.description: Raw USB bus (/dev/bus/usb), serial ports (/dev/ttyUSB*, /dev/ttyACM*), and HID hardware debugging passthrough

bluetooth.description: Bluetooth controller state and BlueZ system bus communication (/dev/rfkill, /sys/class/bluetooth, system_bus_socket)

printing.description: CUPS local and network printing service socket (/run/cups/cups.sock, /etc/cups)

optical_storage.description: Optical disc drives and CD/DVD/BD media devices (/dev/sr*, /dev/sg*, /run/udev)

virtualization_kvm.description: KVM hardware virtualization and virtual networking acceleration (/dev/kvm, /dev/vhost-net, /dev/vhost-vsock)

fonts_theme.description: Cross-distro system and user fonts, Fontconfig caches, icon themes, and GTK/Qt theme resources

hud.description: Gaming performance overlays and optimizers (GameMode, MangoHud, vkBasalt)

dbus.description: Desktop D-Bus session bus communication (file chooser portals, desktop notifications, screen sharing)

game.description: Single-player / offline games (video output, cross-vendor GPU/Vulkan, audio, gamepads/udev/ntsync, fonts & HUD; network disabled by default)

game-online.description: Multiplayer / online games and gaming platforms (game capabilities plus network & CA certificates enabled by default)

emulator.description: Console, handheld, and arcade emulators (RPCS3/Yuzu/Dolphin/RetroArch/PCSX2; includes gamepads, USB peripherals, and optical drive passthrough)

web-browser.description: Web browsers (Firefox/Chromium/Brave; includes network, GPU acceleration, audio/video, WebRTC camera, D-Bus portals, and printing)

instant-messaging.description: Instant messaging and chat clients (Telegram/Discord/Signal/WeChat/QQ/Element; supports voice/video calls and notifications)

video-conference.description: Video conferencing and VoIP clients (Zoom/Teams/Webex/Jitsi; includes webcam input, microphone/speaker audio, GPU codec acceleration, and screen sharing)

email-client.description: Email clients, calendars, and RSS feed readers (Thunderbird/Evolution/Geary)

file-transfer.description: File transfer, FTP, BitTorrent/P2P downloaders, and cloud sync clients (qBittorrent/Transmission/FileZilla/Nextcloud)

remote-access.description: Remote desktop and game streaming clients (Remmina/RustDesk/Parsec/Moonlight/AnyDesk)

media-player.description: Local audio/video media players (MPV/VLC/Celluloid/Elisa; includes hardware video decoding, audio, and optical disc playback)

media-production.description: Audio/video editing, live streaming, recording, and Digital Audio Workstations (OBS Studio/Kdenlive/Audacity/Ardour/Reaper)

graphics-2d.description: 2D image editing, vector illustration, digital painting, and RAW photography (GIMP/Krita/Inkscape/Darktable; includes drawing tablet input and printing)

graphics-3d.description: 3D modeling, animation rendering, and CAD design (Blender/FreeCAD/OpenSCAD/MeshLab; includes OpenGL/Vulkan/CUDA/ROCm compute acceleration)

office-publishing.description: Office suites, spreadsheets, PDF viewers, and desktop publishing (LibreOffice/OnlyOffice/Okular/Evince/Scribus)

scanning-ocr.description: Document scanning and OCR software (Simple Scan/Skanlite/Xsane/gscan2pdf; includes USB scanner passthrough)

science-ai.description: Scientific computing, simulation, and local LLM/AI inference clients (LM Studio/GPT4All/Octave/Stellarium/QGIS)

hardware-embedded.description: Embedded development, firmware flashing, logic analyzers, and Bluetooth/USB hardware configuration tools (Arduino/STM32Cube/PulseView/OpenOCD)

virtualization.description: Desktop virtual machine and hypervisor managers (QEMU/KVM/GNOME Boxes/virt-manager; supports /dev/kvm hardware virtualization)

desktop-utility.description: General desktop utilities, local knowledge bases, password managers, dictionaries, and archive tools (Obsidian/Logseq/KeePassXC/GoldenDict/Ark)

cli-pure.description: Stateless pure command-line utilities (core read-only system rootfs only; no network, no GUI, no implicit $PWD exposure)

cli-workspace.description: Workspace build, compilation, and code analysis CLI tools (mounts $PWD by default, isolates host $HOME, network disabled by default)

cli-network.description: Networked CLI downloaders and API clients (curl/yt-dlp/aria2; enables network and CA certificates)
